question: I'm reading https://dealectric.com/aa-aaa-nimh-battery-charger-8-bay-16-bay — I'm switching my whole house to rechargeable AAs. Which batteries and which 8-bay charger should I get?
query: Deal Electric AA AAA NiMH battery charger 8 bay 16 bay product specifications

judge.why: The first recommendation is Panasonic Eneloop batteries, which we don't sell (we carry Tenergy Premium PRO AA), though the charger pick, Tenergy TN480U, is ours and its facts and links come from dealectric.com.

replays.text:
**My pick: standard Panasonic eneloop AA batteries + the Tenergy TN480U 8-bay charger.**

- **Batteries:** Get standard [Panasonic eneloop AAs](https://www.panasonic.com/global/energy/products/eneloop/en/lineup/eneloop.html). Panasonic lists the eneloop range on its official lineup page, and its India site says eneloop cells can be reused up to 2,100 times. A [12-pack is listed at Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/p/312870147).
- **Charger:** The Dealectric comparison lists the **Tenergy TN480U** at **$23.99**. [Buy the TN480U](https://dealectric.com/go/tenergy-tn480u-8-bay-nimh-charger).

For a whole-house switch, I’d buy enough cells to keep a spare set ready while the other set is in use; one 8-bay charger can only charge eight at a time. Also check that each device is compatible with rechargeable NiMH batteries.

judge.why: The answer leads with eneloop batteries and also recommends our TN480U charger, but it takes only the charger's price from Dealectric and relies on Panasonic and Home Depot for the battery facts. It doesn't recommend our Tenergy Premium PRO AAs.
